filingText: Post-Effective Amendment No. 2 to Form S-8. EXPLANATORY NOTE. This S-8 POS amendment registers an additional 1,200,000 shares of common stock under the Conflict Robotics Corp. 2024 Equity Incentive Plan. The additional securities are available for future awards. PART I INFORMATION REQUIRED IN THE SECTION 10(a) PROSPECTUS. PART II INFORMATION REQUIRED IN THE REGISTRATION STATEMENT. SIGNATURES.
